Online application

Apply without typing the same things twice.

Choose your loan first. If you have applied before, we reuse your saved profile, expenses, bank details and only eligible verified documents.

✓
Your information mattersNever enter your banking PIN, password or OTP anywhere in this form.
Your applicationStep 1 of 6
  1. 1
    LoanAmount and term
  2. 2
    About youPersonal details
  3. 3
    Work & incomeOnly what applies
  4. 4
    AffordabilityMonthly expenses
  5. 5
    Bank & documentsReuse when allowed
  6. 6
    ReviewCheck and submit
Need help?

Your unfinished non-sensitive answers are saved in this browser for up to 7 days.

Visit Help
Step 1

Choose your loan

Your amount and term follow you into the application automatically.

I would like to apply forR 2 500
R500R10 000
Repayment period2 months
1 month6 months
ImportantThis is not a quote or credit offer. Full fees and repayment must be shown before you accept an approved loan.
Continue your applicationWe will quickly verify your ID before the next step.
Continue
Step 2

About you

Use your legal details exactly as they appear on your identification document.

We filled what we already know.Please change anything that is no longer correct.
Linked to your signed-in account.
Step 3

Work and income

We only show questions that make sense for your income type.

Previous income details loaded.Update only what has changed.
R
We calculate your next pay date automatically.
Step 4

Monthly affordability

Enter normal monthly household and debt expenses. We calculate the totals for you.

Previous affordability details loaded.Review them and change anything that is different now.
No need to type them again.These amounts came from your previous application/profile.

This is an affordability input, not an approval result.The lender still needs to assess your application and may request more information.
Step 5

Bank details and documents

Your branch code and account-holder name are handled automatically. Verified documents are reused only when they are still suitable for a new application.

Saved bank details loaded.Check the bank and account number before continuing.
Universal branch code selected automatically.
Filled from your legal first name and surname.
Why some financial documents may be requested againAffordability checks need current income evidence. A verified ID can stay on file, but income evidence and bank statements are reused only while recent enough for a new assessment.

Supporting documents

PDF, JPG or PNG. Maximum 6 MB per file.

Identity document on file ✓
Current proof of income on file ✓
Current bank statement on file ✓
Step 6

Review your application

Check that everything is correct before submitting it to the lender.

After submission, this application appears in your account immediately. Reused documents remain linked to your existing secure file.

Complete all required details, any documents still needed and the three required confirmations to reveal Submit application.
